# Agent Development Kit (ADK)

## Overview

ADK is a self-contained skill toolkit for coding agents. It ships 39 standalone `adk-*` skills, runtime-specific custom subagents for Claude / Cursor / Codex, lifecycle hooks, MCP server configurations, global prompts, and a Node CLI installer that wires everything into Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor (App + CLI), Codex CLI, Codex Desktop, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, and Junie.

Every skill is fully self-contained — one folder with `SKILL.md` and a flat `references/` (no `_shared/`, no shared sources, no cross-skill file references). Reference filenames are **task-prefixed** (e.g., `pr-reviewer-persona.md`, `feature-validator.md`); only `interaction-contract.md` is shared verbatim across skills. Every skill runs a four-phase validator gate (`<task>-validator.md`) at every phase boundary. Every skill is **highly interactive by default** and accepts `--auto` for fully unattended runs.

## Install

Ordered from suggested (top) to most minimal (bottom). The first two paths use the bundled Node CLI and wire up all five surfaces (skills, custom subagents, hooks, MCP servers, global prompts). The `npx skills` path uses the third-party skills.sh loader and lands skills only.

- **Suggested — clone + install script:** `git clone https://github.com/sujeet-pro/agents-devkit.git && cd agents-devkit && npm install && npm run setup`. Symlinks point at the clone; `git pull` refreshes; local edits show up live.
- **npm modules (pinned / CI-reproducible):**
  - Global: `npm install -g agents-devkit && adk-install` (writes into `$HOME`).
  - Per-project: `npm install --save-dev agents-devkit && npx adk-install` (writes into the project's dot-dirs).
- **Non-tech folks — skills only:** `npx skills add sujeet-pro/agents-devkit`. Lands SKILL.md files only; custom subagents, hooks, MCP servers, and global prompts are NOT installed via this path.

For the first two paths, `adk-install` auto-detects which scenario you launched it from. Override with `--mode global|project` or `--root <path>`.

User config: `~/.config/adk/settings.json5`. Project config: `<project>/.adk/settings.json5`.

## Top-level router

- `adk` — activate first for any non-trivial task; routes to a category and a task.

## Category routers

- `adk-plan`, `adk-build`, `adk-review`, `adk-docs`, `adk-audit`, `adk-publish`, `adk-visualize`, `adk-frontend`

## Task skills

Plan: `adk-plan-brainstorm`, `adk-plan-research`, `adk-plan-spec`, `adk-plan-design`, `adk-plan-roadmap`
Build: `adk-build-feature`, `adk-build-refactor`, `adk-build-migrate`, `adk-build-test`, `adk-build-deps`
Review: `adk-review-pr`, `adk-review-local`, `adk-review-feedback`, `adk-review-handoff`
Docs: `adk-docs-write`, `adk-docs-review`
Audit: `adk-audit-repo`, `adk-audit-site`
Publish: `adk-publish-commit`, `adk-publish-github`, `adk-publish-bitbucket`, `adk-publish-confluence`, `adk-publish-gdrive`
Visualize: `adk-visualize-diagram`, `adk-visualize-chart`
Frontend: `adk-frontend-design`, `adk-frontend-feature`, `adk-frontend-react-csr`

## Standalone task skills (no router)

- `adk-doc-site-setup` — bootstrap `@pagesmith/docs` + `diagramkit` and install `prj-doc-site-*` project skills
- `adk-adopt-ai-in-repo` — inspect a target repo, generate `ai-guidelines/` + `AGENTS.md` + `CLAUDE.md` + thin per-agent skill wrappers + Python maintenance hooks; refresh-safe via `--refresh`

## Interaction contract

Every skill ships `references/interaction-contract.md` (identical global contract) AND `references/clarifying-questions.md` (skill-specific questions with how-to-pick rubrics for each option). Default mode: present 2-3 options at every meaningful decision with `Pros / Cons / Best when / Blast radius / Reversibility`, mark one `(default)`, ask one question, wait. `--auto` mode: skip approval gates, take the documented default, still validate, still report. Never auto-execute irreversible destructive ops the skill marks "never auto" (pr-merge, force-push, prod deploy, schema drop, billing, etc.). Same contract is mirrored as `global-prompts/interaction-contract.md` so it lands in every runtime memory file.

## Per-skill references

Every skill ships these unique-per-skill task-prefixed files: `<task>-persona.md`, `<task>-constitution.md` (or `<task>-standards.md` for review-style skills), `<task>-clarifying-questions.md`, `<task>-output-format.md`, `<task>-artifact-format.md`, `<task>-anti-patterns.md`, `<task>-validator.md` (the four-phase validator gate). Skills consulting primary sources also ship `<task>-research-protocol.md`. Skills supporting cross-repo context (research, spec, design, docs-write, docs-review, audit-repo) also ship `<task>-multi-repo.md` and accept `--repo <url-or-path>` (repeatable; URLs cloned into `.temp/reference-repos/<owner>__<repo>/`). Review-style skills ship `<task>-comment-format.md`, `<task>-reply-templates.md`, `<task>-comment-reconciliation.md`, `<task>-postback-protocol.md` for the bold-label canonical posted-comment shape (`**[Type][focus] Title**` / `**Confidence:** X/100 | **Dimension:** ... | **Guideline:** ...` / `**Issue Explanation:** / **Suggested Fix:** / **Impact:**`). Frontend skills ship `<task>-design-system-master.md`, `<task>-pre-delivery-checklist.md`, `<task>-industry-anti-patterns.md`. The single shared file across all skills is `interaction-contract.md`.

## MCP servers

- `github`, `bitbucket`, `confluence`, `jira`, `google-drive`, `brainstorming`

Each server JSON declares `${ENV_VAR}` placeholders. The installer reads/writes them via `~/.zshenv` and merges the resolved config into each runtime's `mcp.json`.

## Working artifact contract

All intermediate output goes under `.temp/` in the host repo (gitignored). Never write scratch outside `.temp/`.

## Maintenance

- `npm run validate` — validate skills, agents, hooks.
- `npm run skills:manifest` — regenerate `skills-manifest.json`.
- `npm run docs:build` — build `gh-pages/` from `docs/`.
